text:
maria: Heads up — Deimos private VPC deploy window scheduled for Fri 2026-03-13 22:00 UTC. Plan = DB schema migration (non-destructive), runtime config flip, canary rollout 5% -> 25% -> 100%. Need a primary on-call, smoke owner, and rollback readiness.

ajay: I'll be primary oncall for the window. I can run rollback steps if needed. @lucy can you own the smoke tests?

lucy: Can do. I'll run the smoke checklist and post results in this thread. Which target for smoke — staging or prod canary?

samir: Run against the prod canary group. I'll create the canary host and tag it `deimos-canary-1` so smoke scripts hit the right pool.

deploy-bot: Scheduled deploy job created: job id deimos-20260313-2200, creator: maria, steps: build -> deploy -> canary -> promote.

maria: Quick smoke checklist (short):
- health endpoints return 200
- sample generation using model v2 (sanity)
- p95 latency < 200ms
- error rate < 0.5%
Commands to run:
```
./smoke/run_smoke.sh --host deimos-canary-1 --tests quick
curl -sS https://deimos-canary-1.internal/health
```
I'll also verify logs for 5xx spike and model load success.

lucy: Noted. I'll run those and paste results here. ETA ~15m after the canary is up.

ajay: Rollback plan summary: disable routing to canary, promote previous model tag, and restart affected node pool. Samir — you have the rollback runbook link?

samir: Yep: https://wiki.redwood/ops/deploys/deimos-rollback — I have access and can execute steps. I can rollback within ~10m of an explicit decision. Need @maria to approve before I run it.

ben: QA will run a small data-integrity smoke (sample inputs) after canary promotion. Expect ~10m for that.

maria: Code review check: PR #4827 contains the migration. @eli can you do a quick LGTM if infra/migration looks good?

eli: Reviewing now. Quick question about the backfill window — it looks safe but I'll leave a short comment on the PR.

lucy: If we see latency spikes, we should throttle canary down to 1% and keep monitoring (don't promote).

ajay: I'll be on pager and Slack for the window. Ping here or call me if you see anything urgent.

maria: I'll run a final preflight at 21:30 UTC and post a 'ready' message. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Reminder scheduled 1h before deploy (will post again at 21:00 UTC).
